import os

base_path = "~/documents/work/meetings_data/"
all_entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=base_path)

# Filter only files (those with extensions that match the pattern)
files_to_move = []
for entry in all_entries:
    # Get just the filename
    filename = os.path.basename(entry)
    # Check if it matches the pattern <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
    if "__" in filename and "." in filename:
        # Parse: <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
        date_part, rest = filename.split("__", 1)
        file_name, extension = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
        files_to_move.append({
            "original_path": base_path + filename,
            "date": date_part,
            "file_name": file_name,
            "extension": extension
        })

print(f"Found {len(files_to_move)} files to move")
for f in files_to_move[:5]:
    print(f)
